entities.name: Yannick Souvré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yannick Souvré is a French former basketball player who competed in the 2000 Summer Olympics. She was born in Toulouse. She was inducted into the French Basketball Hall of Fame, in 2011. She was awarded with the Glory of Sport in 2013.
